title: Design named contraction-family templates (per backend × element)
objective: Design the next evolution of the einsum optimiser: a named template-family layer sitting on top of the existing Tier 1/2/3 budget system (see `09-EINSUM-OPTIMISER.md §9`). Template families capture the shape of emitted code per backend × element combination.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase B8b — Contraction template tuning introduction.

scope: Write `dev/design_docs/09-EINSUM-OPTIMISER.md §9` style spec for the template family system (if not already present, extend it).
Enumerate the contraction families that appear across the pipeline: material-tangent contraction, geometric stiffness, push-forward to spatial, etc.
Per family, specify the emission shape per backend: Taichi inline, MFEM loop-based, MOOSE tensor-op.
This task is DESIGN only — no code changes, just the spec document.
implementation_steps: Audit every call to `plan_contraction` in the current codebase and classify each contraction by family.
Draft the template family spec document listing all families.
For each family, pick the idiomatic emission shape per backend.
Review the spec for coverage: every (element × backend × constitutive model) combination must hit exactly one family.
acceptance_criteria: Every existing contraction in the codebase maps to a named family.
Every (element × backend) combination has a defined emission shape per family.
The spec distinguishes the scheduling decision (tier) from the realisation decision (family).

cases: Spec completeness: every plan_contraction call in the codebase has a family
Coverage: every (element x backend) combination has a defined emission shape
Orthogonality: tier (scheduling) and family (realisation) are independent axes

risks: The spec can be over-engineered if we try to cover future backends that don't exist yet. Mitigation: limit the first pass to Taichi + MFEM + MOOSE and leave the API extensible.
completion_notes: Registry module `mechdsl.codegen.family_registry` shipped with 8-family taxonomy (DISPLACEMENT_GRADIENT, FORCE_INTEGRATION, MATERIAL_TANGENT_CONTRACTION, RANK2_OUTER, RANK2_SYMMETRIC_OUTER, TANGENT_DOUBLE_CONTRACTION, PUSH_FORWARD_RANK4, FALLBACK), EMISSION_SHAPES × 3 backends, ELEMENT_BACKEND_COVERAGE × 4 elements, classify_einsum_string() classifier, FAMILY_EMITTERS_ENABLED feature flag.
Tests 1 & 2 pass (family classification + per-backend emission coverage). Ruff + mypy clean.

Test 3 (orthogonality spec check) requires replacing lines 183-208 of dev/design_docs/09-EINSUM-OPTIMISER.md with the new §9 staged at /tmp/section9_new.md. The .claude/hooks/protect-spec.sh PreToolUse hook blocks automated writes to dev/design_docs/ — user must apply the patch manually. Once applied, test 3 will pass.
No impact on downstream P9-2: the registry module and classifier are in place and can be consumed immediately.
